configuration: strict caller supplied; no executable defaults; schema digest-bound

ownership.soil_thermal: all soil-layer temperatures and enthalpies plus validated equal/opposite ground-heat receipt
ownership.vegetation: canopy, gas exchange, plant hydraulics, root requests, and occupancy state

radiation.longwave: V8 reciprocal arbitrary-rank unit-emissivity source-resolved network

transaction_order: joint potential solve; source-keyed vegetation and ground requests; one immutable real-hydrology authorization; fixed-cap joint rebuild from beginning owners; finalized use; post-solve ingress/infiltration/runoff/advection
water_transaction: one potential request batch, one real authorization, fixed-cap rebuild from immutable beginning state
